$comment: Sundays block (L-065), proper of time: Sundays of Advent, Lent, Easter (2-7) and Ordinary Time (2-33), Years A/B/C. Year A is imported from LitCal (import/litcal/sundays.json). LitCal has no Year B or C data at the pinned revision, so B and C are filled from the OLM 1981 structure, cited by OLM lectionary number; their pages (p?) and printed forms are recorded by the verifier. Sundays 25 and 26 (Year A) stay in the seed block (seed/proper-of-time.json); their Years B and C are not here because a key may be defined only once. Every entry is provisional until checked against the Kenyan Lectionary (docs/decisions/011-lectionary-source.md).
